images.name: carry-question
images.prompt:
CRITICAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS: Return a PNG with exact pixel dimensions 1024 wide by 1024 high. Do not return 1254x1254 or 1280x1280. This is a hard asset requirement. Use flat uniform solid color fills only, absolutely no mottling, paper texture, gradients or lighting. The whole character plus held object must occupy only 70% of the canvas width with equal left/right transparent margins. Strongly lean the entire leaf body forward to the RIGHT for a flying pose; avoid upright standing or front-facing posture. Render ONE sprite only.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone PNG sprite named carry-question for an animated web system diagram. Canvas MUST be square 1024x1024 with true transparent alpha background.
Input images: looking.png and found.png are character identity references, not a scene or background to reproduce. Match this exact leaf mascot, its shapes, face, outline, limbs, and bottom coral bow. Repose it as described below.
Subject: exactly ONE teardrop-shaped leaf whose single leaf is the entire head and body, flat solid green #009C75, one simple light mint centre vein, very thick rounded navy #172033 outline, two navy dot eyes, small curved smile, soft pink-coral solid cheeks, tiny rounded green arms and legs outlined in navy. One coral #F04B3E ribbon bow tied at the bottom stem with short tails.
Pose: the leaf is flying to the RIGHT in a clean readable side/three-quarter view, body leaning forward to the right. The tip points upper-right, the stem and tiny legs trail lower-left. Ribbon tails stream behind to the LEFT. Both tiny hands extend forward on the RIGHT, visibly holding ONE small empty rounded speech bubble in front of the body. The speech bubble has warm white #FFFDF8 solid fill, thick navy outline and a simple small tail, with a completely BLANK interior: no question mark, no dots, no letters, no symbols, no marks.
Style: pure flat solid color illustration, bold simple silhouette and thick outlines, almost no fine detail. It must remain legible at 40-56 pixels tall. Keep the face readable and the bubble separate from the face.
Composition: complete figure and held bubble centered as one compact group occupying about 70% of the canvas width, with even clear margins. No clipping.
Strict exclusions: NO gradients, glow, halo, shadows, textures, lighting effects, motion trails, extra props, extra characters, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. The empty canvas surrounding the sprite must have real fully transparent alpha, never white, black or checkerboard pixels. Do not draw a background box or checkerboard.
